verdict.rationale: Trello documents a general integration ecosystem: Power-Ups that link teams' favorite tools, an app directory, and a REST API with webhooks. It also pitches itself to design teams for creative requests. In principle this lets a design tool push status into Trello, but nothing shows a design-tool integration that lets a designer update cards without leaving that tool. Missing for 10: any named design-tool integration (e.g., a plugin inside a design app), documented two-way status updates from the design tool, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
